cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

extra.message: User input params["object"] is decoded and passed directly to pickle.loads(params["object"].encode()). pickle is not safe against untrusted data; a crafted pickle payload yields arbitrary code execution (RCE) on the server.

extra.message: The 'path' query parameter is passed to open(os.path.abspath(params["path"]), "rb"). os.path.abspath only resolves relative paths; it does not confine to a directory, so ../../../etc/passwd reads arbitrary local files.

extra.message: The 'name' query parameter is concatenated directly into an XPath query: .xpath(".//user[name/text()='%s']" % params["name"]). An attacker can break out of the string (e.g. name=' or '1'='1) to manipulate the XPath result set.
